encoders.graph: 3-layer R-GCN, width 256, basis decomposition (<=8 bases), mean aggregation
encoders.audio: 4-block 1D conv (k 64/32/16/8, s 8/4/2/2) + 6-layer Transformer, width 512 (implemented, not evaluated)

skga.entity_embeddings: frozen SciBERT mean-pooled embeddings of entity names

baselines.unimodal: one encoder + mean pool + projection to 512; best modality by validation score
baselines.late_fusion: per-modality projection + classifier; logits averaged over present modalities
baselines.cross_modal_attention: MulT-style; 2 pre-norm cross-attention layers per ordered modality pair, width 768; merge + 1 self-attention layer
baselines.mm_bert: MAG gate after BERT layer 1, beta 0.5

inputs.graph: ego graph: paper + up to 31 citation neighbours, induced edges, relations {cites, cited-by}
